mechanism_narrative: Sustained week-on-week recovery in RETAIL_REC (from -37.3% to -13.4% over 3 weeks) indicates a monotonic trend toward baseline. This momentum persists into the next 4 weeks, driving RETAIL_REC higher than the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 23.9 percentage points over 3 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days falls below the mean of the last 28 days, or reverses direction for 2 consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has surged from -4.1% to +19.0% over 3 weeks, signaling restored consumer confidence in essential shopping. This confidence spillover drives discretionary RETAIL_REC visits upward over the next 2 weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose 23.1 percentage points in 3 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase week-on-week in at least 2 of the next 4 weeks when GROCERY_PHARM remains above +15%.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 27.2 percentage points over 3 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase in the week immediately following TRANSIT exceeding -5%.

evidence_refs: fact:both series show sustained recovery trajectory
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the last 28-day mean when both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT improve for 2 consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has declined from +13.0% to +5.4%, indicating reduced home confinement. Declining RESIDENTIAL paired with rising GROCERY_PHARM signals outdoor mobility resumption, which extends to RETAIL_REC over 2 weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell 7.6 points as GROCERY_PHARM rose 23.1 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase in at least 3 of the next 4 weeks when RESIDENTIAL declines and GROCERY_PHARM rises concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility remains severely depressed at -15.3% despite 22.6 percentage point recovery. Persistent outdoor activity suppression indicates ongoing restrictions. When PARKS remains below -10%, RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed below its 4-week baseline mean.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at -15.3% despite strong recovery trend
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the last 28-day mean when PARKS remains below -10% for 2 consecutive weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days falls below the last 28-day mean when WORKPLACES remains below -10% and RETAIL_REC is above -20%.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT recovery from -29.3% to -2.1% combined with PARKS remaining severely depressed at -15.3% indicates transit is enabling retail/urban mobility rather than park access. This substitution effect sustains RETAIL_REC elevation over 1 week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT exceeds -5% while PARKS remains below -10%
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT near baseline while PARKS severely depressed
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase week-on-week when TRANSIT exceeds -5% and PARKS remains below -10% in the same week.
